correction.note: ROOT CAUSE FOUND, and it is an ORDERING BUG not a threshold. The crown gates at server.py:1140/1147 read res['speed'], but res['speed'] is not corrected to the true measured value until server.py:1240. Shazam matched this slowed clip straight at 1.0x so edit_label was 'as posted', the gate refused the candidate for 'contradicting' that, and only AFTERWARDS did speed_from_master.measure_consensus report 0.8494 = slowed ~0.85x. Independently confirmed: the clip runs 0.80-0.85x against normal-speed uploads. The final payload shows the right speed; the decision used the wrong one. This likely explains most of the 11 held-back clips that had a 1.00 candidate refused with the reason 'clip measured as posted'.
